part1.intro: The examiner asks the candidate about him/herself, his/her home, work or studies and other familiar topics.

topics.title: Songs and singing
questions: Did you enjoy singing when you were younger? [Why?/Why not?]
How often do you sing now? [Why?]
Do you have a favourite song you like listening to? [Why?/Why not?]
How important is singing in your culture? [Why?]

part2.topic: Describe a film/movie actor from your country who is very popular.
points: what kinds of films/movies he/she acts in
what you know about this actor's life
part2.closing: and explain why this actor is so popular.

topics.title: Watching films/movies
questions: What are the most popular types of films in your country?
What is the difference between watching a film in the cinema and watching a film at home?
Do you think cinemas will close in the future?

topics.title: Theatre
questions: How important is the theatre in your country's history?
How strong a tradition is it today in your country to go to the theatre?
Do you think the theatre should be run as a business or as a public service?
